facts.fact: Decree 2026-002 of 21 January 2026 cites, among its legal bases, law no. 2022-07 of 27 June 2022 on the organisation and regulation of statistical activities in Benin.
facts.system: Loi n° 2022-07 portant organisation et réglementation des activités statistiques, 2022

systems.system: Loi n° 2022-07 portant organisation et réglementation des activités statistiques, 2022

note: Decree approves a cultural-occupations nomenclature; it only cites the 2022 statistics law as a legal basis and is not a rule made under it.
